payload.title: event-tap cannot reach claude's act events
payload.body: On Claude Code the tap refuses operator.consult.pre and subagent.dispatch.pre, saying 'Claude Code fires no native event', though the projection binds both as PreToolUse narrowed by tool matcher (claude/events.ts). The host runtime config's claude stanza carries 19 name-only natives and no act bindings, so the tap has no matcher (forge deploy/runtime-config.ts harnessStanza; runtime claude-serialize.ts buildEventTapBlock). Also: install then uninstall in a cwd with no .claude leaves .claude/settings.json holding {}, breaking the skill's law that uninstall restores the target to its prior state.
